newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand to discuss Natuna gas purchase.
newsitem.headline: Thailand to discuss Natuna gas purchase.

text.p: Thailand will discuss the possible purchase of natural gas from Indonesia's Natuna project with Indonesian authorities on Wednesday, an industry ministry official said.
Industry Minister Korn Dabbaransi will hold a meeting with Indonesia's Minister of State for Research and Technology B.J. Habibieu, the official told Reuters.
Executives from Exxon Corp, which holds a 50 percent stake in the project, and Mobil Corp will also participate in the meeting, he said.

The Natuna Field is one of the largest natural gas fields in the world. It contains an estimated 222 trillion cubic feet of gas, of which 46 trillion cubic feet are thought to be commercially recoverable.

If Thailand decides to purchase gas from the field, it is likely that PTT Exploration and Production Plc, a unit of state-run Petroleum Authority of Thailand, will invest in the project, the official said.
